turns.q: Which of my disks has the most power-on hours?
turns.a: In this demo setup the two 6 TB hard disks (sda and sdb) have the most hours, about 14,800 each. The NVMe system disk has around 6,000 hours and 5 percent wear. All three pass SMART, so nothing needs replacing yet.

turns.q: Should I scrub the pools soon?
turns.a: Both pools were scrubbed about 17 days ago with no errors. A monthly scrub is a good rhythm, so the next one is due in roughly two weeks.

turns.q: Give me a short checklist for a homelab maintenance weekend.
turns.a:
1. Check backups ran and restore one file as a test.
2. Apply pending updates to the host and the containers, one at a time.
3. Look at disk temperatures and SMART.
4. Run a ZFS scrub if the last one is older than a month.
5. Write down what you changed.
